summary.text: Susan Pha is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 38 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before the Senate she served on the Brooklyn Park City Council, and she has worked as a real estate consultant and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Susan Pha lives in Brooklyn Park, Minnesota.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a real estate consultant and as a small business owner.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she came to the United States 45 years ago as a four-year-old refugee, worked in the nonprofit sector and ran a small business, and has served in public office from the Brooklyn Park City Council to the State Senate.
Pha took office in the Senate on January 3, 2023, succeeding Roger Chamberlain.
She said in the survey that she was chief author of the homeowners' association reform bill in the Senate.
She listed property taxes and the cost of living, affordable health care and safe neighborhoods, and good jobs and opportunity among her campaign messages.
